replacement_plan: OpenBot native pure-JSON card builders in services/feishu_gateway/src/openbot_feishu/cards.py
reason: Both nanobot and LangBot couple card templates with in-memory channel buses, first-user auto-pairing, or direct SDK send calls. Writing OpenBot-owned pure dict card constructors is simpler, avoids vendoring upstream runtime assumptions, and keeps EgressGuard/Outbox authority intact.
